title: A Tool-Augmented, GPT-4 Chatbot for Real-Time Repository Data Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.07586v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software repositories contain vast amounts of data on code contributions, bug reports, and project activities, yet this information remains challenging for non-technical stakeholders and developers to access due to limited expertise in querying repositories. To address this, we introduce a novel chatbot architecture leveraging OpenAI's GPT-4 model for automated extraction and analysis of repository data. In contrast, our architecture takes a structured path first by parsing the user's query to extract relevant parameters, then selecting the correct tool to employ based on that analysis, and finally invoking the GPT-4 model to create a highly detailed response. In contrast to previous work based on multi-component systems with embedding models and document retrievers, our architecture inverts the process by relying on prompt engineering and tool selection to fit with the query intent. translated_title: 一种工具增强的、基于GPT-4的实时仓库数据分析聊天机器人
translated_abstract: 软件仓库中包含大量关于代码贡献、错误报告和项目活动的数据，然而由于缺乏查询仓库所需的专业知识，这些信息对于非技术利益相关者和开发者来说仍然难以获取。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的聊天机器人架构，利用OpenAI的GPT-4模型实现仓库数据的自动化提取与分析。我们的架构首先采用结构化路径，通过解析用户查询来提取相关参数，然后基于该分析选择正确的工具，最后调用GPT-4模型生成高度详细的回复。与以往基于嵌入模型和文档检索器的多组件系统工作相比，我们的架构反转了这一流程，依靠提示工程和工具选择来匹配查询意图。为了验证我们的方法，我们进行了实验。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种工具增强的GPT-4聊天机器人架构，通过解析用户查询参数、选择合适工具并调用GPT-4生成详细回复，颠覆了传统基于嵌入模型和文档检索器的多组件方法，实现了软件仓库数据的自动化提取与分析。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a tool-augmented GPT-4 chatbot architecture that parses user query parameters, selects the appropriate tool, and invokes GPT-4 to generate detailed responses, inverting the traditional multi-component approach of embedding models and document retrievers for automated software repository data analysis.
